one_line_contribution: That agent-memory harm is caused by commitment order rather than injected volume or item content, tested by a token-matched commit-then-consult arm (A2) plus a slot-routing arm (G3) and one genuinely risky prediction: GEPA-optimized instructions should make memory-first injection more harmful (G1 vs A1), not less.
closest_prior_work: The proposal names CoVe, Astute/Madam-RAG, Self-Refine and Speculative RAG, but misses the cluster that most threatens it: the knowledge-conflict RAG literature. Xie et al., Adaptive Chameleon or Stubborn Sloth (ICLR 2024), directly studies whether an LLM abandons a prior answer when shown conflicting external evidence, and reports that eliciting the model's own answer or self-generated evidence before presenting the external evidence changes receptiveness and induces confirmation bias toward the elicited prior. That is commit-then-consult, measured, with the same causal story (prior commitment resists override), differing only in that the evidence is a retrieved document rather than a distilled experience item. Longpre et al. 2021 (entity-based knowledge conflicts), Zhou et al. 2023 (context-faithful prompting, opinion-based framing to reduce over-reliance on context) and GenRead (Yu et al. 2023, generate-then-read) surround the same finding. Combined with CoVe, which the proposal concedes, this makes A2 a port of an established RAG effect into the agent-memory setting rather than a new causal lever. What is not clearly anticipated is P4, the ordering x instruction-optimization interaction; that is where the novelty actually lives, and it is the least-powered arm.
strongest_objection: P1, the headline and self-declared best-powered endpoint, is close to true by construction. In A2, pass 1 is a no-memory run, and a break is scored against A0, which is also a no-memory run. An A2 agent that is merely draft-sticky converges on A0 and therefore on zero breaks, with no anchoring account required; the break-halving in P1 measures revision reluctance, not the mechanism. The only non-degenerate endpoint is P2, fix preservation, which the proposal itself concedes is detectable only to about 3 points, and which the cited pilot (bank fixed zero items) may render undefined, since the dev precheck can fail and the proposal states no contingency beyond reporting it. Second, and worse for the sharpest claim: P4 compares break proportions across arms with different reference accuracies. G0 will be more accurate than A0, so the pool of reference-correct instances available to be broken is larger under I-star, and an unconditional break proportion rises mechanically even if the per-item override probability is identical. The predicted 1.5x ratio and 3-point absolute gap are exactly the size a base-rate shift produces. Nothing in the analysis section conditions the break rate on the reference-correct subset, so the anti-synergy result as specified is confounded in the direction of the prediction. Third, G3 is described as isolating slot from order with the same directive content, but a budget-capped GEPA run merges only the surviving directives, so G3 varies slot, optimizer vetting, and content selection at once; G3 vs A1 cannot support the slot claim as written. Finally, the practical payoff is thin even on success: A7 (k=3) reportedly already eliminated the harm at half of A2's call cost, and if the bank fixes nothing, A0 dominates every memory arm, so the paper can win P1 and still recommend nothing.
what_would_fix_it: 1) Redefine every break endpoint conditionally, breaks divided by reference-correct instances, and run the P4 difference-in-differences on conditional flip probabilities, with G0 vs A0 accuracy reported alongside so the reader can see the base-rate shift is removed; without this P4 is uninterpretable. 2) Report A2 keep-rate and the A2-vs-A0 first-action agreement, and pre-register a floor: a draft-stickiness figure that would make P1 vacuous. 3) Make the dev precheck a hard gate with a stated fallback (a stronger bank, an environment where retrieved experience demonstrably fixes items, or an explicit demotion of the paper to a one-sided harm-reduction claim). 4) Manipulate directiveness instead of only annotating it: add an arm rewriting retrieved items imperative-to-declarative at fixed content, slot, order and token count. 5) Split G3 into slot-only (verbatim extracted directives appended to the instruction, no GEPA pass) and slot-plus-vetting. 6) Run I-star from at least three GEPA seeds; one draw cannot carry an interaction claim the authors already call the weakest arm. 7) Cite and position against the knowledge-conflict literature above.
missing_baseline: Two. (a) A declarative-rewrite arm: the identical retrieved items rewritten from imperative to descriptive/episodic form, injected memory-first at matched tokens. This is the only direct manipulation of the proposal's central construct, instruction-shaped content in the demonstration slot; as the grid stands, directiveness is purely observational (an annotation regression) and A6 rewrites for query relevance, not for grammatical mood, so it does not substitute. (b) A GEPA run with memory in the loop, producing an instruction optimized against the memory-first context. That is the composition the track actually asks about and the natural comparator for anti-synergy; as specified, I-star is optimized memory-free and then deployed with memory, so any G1 degradation is equally explained by instruction-context mismatch rather than by a stronger prior being abandoned. A slot-only routing condition without GEPA vetting is a third, needed to decontaminate G3.
preprint_collision: Above the median for effort and unusually honest, but not sufficient. It names specific IDs, gives per-item collide/no-collide verdicts, concedes CoVe as a structural ancestor after reviewer pressure, and self-reports an unfinished sweep. Two problems. First, the admitted gap sits exactly on the load-bearing claim: the authors themselves assign nontrivial probability to a draft-then-consult ordering ablation existing in an OpenReview or ACL/EMNLP appendix, and they did not look. An unsearched region containing the paper's main intervention is a weakness, not a neutral. Second, an entire relevant cluster is absent: nothing in the check covers knowledge-conflict RAG (Xie et al. ICLR 2024, Longpre et al. 2021, context-faithful prompting, GenRead), where the effect of eliciting a model's own answer before showing conflicting evidence is close to established; searching only agent-memory venues will not surface it. Citation hygiene also slips, Astute RAG and Madam-RAG are merged under 2504.13079 when they are separate papers with separate IDs, which lowers confidence in the rest of the ID list. Net: I did not find a preprint that already makes the P4 anti-synergy claim, and I judge that part plausibly unclaimed; the A2 ordering claim is not established as novel by this check.
